audit.whatIsWrong: Ornn's W and E are swapped throughout, and Brittle is attributed to the wrong ability. early: "his W (Searing Charge) dashes and, if he hits a wall, stuns and applies brittle". wants.foe[0]: "Land Searing Charge (W) into a wall to brittle you". Also spikes[1].text, wants.you[1], whys[2] and whys[3].
audit.why: Three separate errors compound here. Searing Charge is Ornn's E, not his W. It knocks up on terrain collision — it does not stun. And it does not apply Brittle at all: Brittle comes from Bellows Breath (W), whose text reads 'Enemies hit by the final gout of flame become Brittle'. A Nasus who has been told the dash applies Brittle will dodge the wrong ability and eat the real one.
audit.corrected: Bellows Breath (W) applies Brittle. Searing Charge (E) is the dash that knocks up on terrain collision.

audit.whatIsWrong: content.mid and whys[3] refer to "E pillar" poke.
audit.why: The magma pillar is created by Volcanic Rupture (Q) — 'After a small delay, a magma pillar forms at the end location.' Ornn's E creates no pillar. This one matters more than a naming nit because the pillar is the terrain his own Searing Charge collides with: Q pillar into E charge is his entire self-sufficient knockup combo, and calling the pillar an E hides that link completely.
audit.corrected: Volcanic Rupture (Q) drops the pillar; Searing Charge (E) into that pillar is the knockup.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns gives Volcanic Rupture no cooldown number.
audit.why: Volcanic Rupture is 9/8.5/8/7.5/7 at 800 range. The existing description 'Wall-knockup setup' is actually correct — the pillar is the wall he charges into — but with no number the player cannot time the window.
audit.corrected: Add the 9-to-7s cooldown and keep the wall-knockup framing.

audit.why: 48.51% over 670 games with an EVEN / 6-10 label and a chart that gives Ornn only levels 4-5 and Nasus the two-item stage. That matches a scaling tank duel Nasus edges late.

edits.before: Neither of you wins this — Ornn has no sustain threat and can't kill you, so just farm Q. Last-hit with the bonus-damage Q and soak Spirit Fire (E) over the wave to stack faster while shoving him under tower. The one thing to respect early is his brittle: his W (Searing Charge) dashes and, if he hits a wall, stuns and applies brittle so his next hit chunks you — so don't hug terrain when his W is up.
edits.after: Neither of you wins this — Ornn has no sustain threat and can't kill you, so just farm Q. Last-hit with the bonus-damage Q and soak Spirit Fire (E) over the wave to stack faster while shoving him under tower. Get his combo straight: Bellows Breath (W) is what applies Brittle, and Searing Charge (E) is the dash that knocks up if he hits terrain — so don't hug walls when his E is up.

edits.before: Levels 3-5 are the only window Ornn edges, because his W-into-wall brittle plus E pillar can poke you down while your Wither alone can't stop the burst — play to the open side of the lane and keep stacking. At 6 the lane evens back out: Fury of the Sands' bonus HP and Wither's huge slow let you eat his R double-knockup all-in and walk away, so he can't solo you anymore. Don't force a kill you can't get — just farm and deny.
edits.after: Levels 3-5 are the only window Ornn edges, because Volcanic Rupture (Q) drops a pillar he can then Searing Charge into for a knockup, with Bellows Breath brittling you on top — play to the open side of the lane and keep stacking. At 6 the lane evens back out: Fury of the Sands' bonus HP and Wither's huge slow let you eat his R knockup all-in and walk away. Don't force a kill you can't get — just farm and deny.

edits.before: Ornn's biggest window: he point-blank brittles you with W (Searing Charge into a wall) and follows with E to chunk you while you have no Wither answer to his burst.
edits.after: Ornn's biggest window: Bellows Breath (W) brittles you and Searing Charge (E) into his own Q pillar knocks you up, while you have no Wither answer to the burst.

edits.before: Dodge the brittle combo: don't stand next to a wall when his W (Searing Charge) is up
edits.after: Dodge the knockup — never stand next to terrain when his Searing Charge (E) is up

edits.before: Land Searing Charge (W) into a wall to brittle you, then E or auto to detonate it for bonus damage
edits.after: Brittle you with Bellows Breath (W), then Searing Charge (E) into terrain for the knockup follow-up

edits.before: Even — you have Wither now but a single point-and-click slow can't fully answer his W-wall brittle plus E poke.
edits.after: Even — you have Wither now but one point-and-click slow can't answer his Brittle plus a pillar-charge knockup.

edits.before: Ornn edges this window: Searing Charge into terrain brittles you and his E pillar pokes while your stacks aren't paying off yet.
edits.after: Ornn edges this window: Searing Charge into terrain knocks you up and Bellows Breath brittles, while your stacks aren't paying yet.

edits.before: - Ornn Volcanic Rupture: matchup-defining — Wall-knockup setup. Don’t get pinned. Track it before every engage.
edits.after: - Ornn Volcanic Rupture: matchup-defining — 9-7s pillar he then charges into for the knockup. Don't stand near it.

notes: The packet caught "Land Searing Charge (W)" in wants.foe[0] and it is a genuine error, but the real scope was larger than one string: the W/E swap and the misattributed Brittle ran through six strings across the matchup. The packet's other Ornn suspectName, "Spirit Fire's" in late, is a false positive — that is Nasus's own E, correctly named, and I left that string untouched. I did not touch the "R double-knockup" phrasing in spikes[2].text and whys[4]; Call of the Forge God does knock up on the recast, so the description is loose but not wrong.
